title: AI-CTA: AI-Industrial Predictive Safety
description:
Reference implementation of a predictive safety framework for high-hazard industrial facilities, implementing the algorithms and architecture described in the accompanying monograph Artificial Intelligence for Preventing Accidents at High-Risk Industrial Facilities (Serebriakov, 2026).

The package provides: IsolationForest + LSTM anomaly detection, RUL quantile regression, neural risk estimation, three-component hybrid risk aggregation with SLSQP weight calibration on the 2-simplex, conformal threshold calibration for controlled false-alarm rate, PSI + KS distribution drift detection, online recalibration, a FastAPI REST service, a Docker-compose production stack (9 containers), 62 unit + integration tests, and reproducibility benchmarks on NASA C-MAPSS (turbofan RUL), CWRU Bearing (fault classification), and Bosch CNC Machining (cross-domain vibration anomaly detection) datasets.

Ablation and baseline comparison scripts are included for reviewers of Scopus / IEEE journals.
